documents.subject: Request for payroll movement clarification
documents.body:
Hello,

Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. is reviewing the payroll record identified as PAY-003, dated 2025-03-31. Please provide any available explanation for the recorded gross, withholding, employer, and net fields, and clarify whether any related external movement has been confirmed. Under the stated settlement policy, proposals are not settlements, so confirmation status is important. If supporting details or approvals exist, please identify them for review. No additional payment or approval is assumed by this request.

Regards,
Casey Team05

documents.body:
Service and settlement excerpt for company identifier MERIDIAN-001:

“Only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements.”

It does not establish that a particular movement occurred, that a proposal was approved, or that any payment was made. For payroll record PAY-003, dated 2025-03-31, additional explanation and confirmation status remain matters for review. No other commercial, legal, or payment terms are supplied here.
